name: Ai-RGUS
why: https://ai-rgus.com answers HTTP 302 to https://airgus.com, which answers HTTP 202 with a 168-byte Sucuri body whose only content is <meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0;/.well-known/sgcaptcha/?r=%2F&y=ipc:..."> - a bot-detection challenge, not a page. Tried https://ai-rgus.com, https://www.ai-rgus.com, https://ai-rgus.com/about/, https://airgus.com (all 202 challenge) and http://ai-rgus.com (ConnectTimeout). add_company.fetch() correctly discards all of them as blocked, so nothing identifiable was ever served. I did not attempt to solve or bypass the challenge. Note this is NOT evidence the company has no site: the redirect ai-rgus.com -> airgus.com shows something is live behind the wall. Needs a human with a browser.

name: Decision Optimization Technology-US
why: I found the PRODUCT everywhere and the COMPANY nowhere, and what the product does is not what we say this company sells. Tried https://dot-us.com and https://www.dot-us.com (SSLError), https://decisionoptimizationtechnology.com (ConnectionError), plus the two sites that do carry it. https://www.bettercapitalplanning.com passes identifies() (present=["decision","optimization"], title "Decision Optimization Technology(TM)") but its footer reads "(c) 2021 Hanson Professional Services Inc." and the word Hanson appears 10 times - it is Hanson's product site, not DOT-US's. https://www.infrasolglobal.com/dot.html also passes identifies() and is Infrastructure Solutions (Software) Inc's page for the same product. Esri's partner directory lists bettercapitalplanning.com as DOT-US's website, but the page never says "DOT-US". Second failure: we say "Route and operations optimization software"; both pages say asset management and capital planning, and "route" appears zero times on either. Accepting either host would be exactly the Vocalis shape - a page that passes the name check while being a different entity selling a different thing. Left blank on purpose; our own 'what they sell' line probably needs fixing too.
